title: Tree toggle, collapse, and default expand in Current Status
description:
As a Kanbus user I want a collapsible hierarchy in Current Status so I can scan roll-up summaries without leaving the feed.

Feature: Console current status panel

  Scenario: Tree toggle shows hierarchical status feed
    Given the console is open
    And no issues exist in the console
    And the console right now configuration has default_tree_expanded true
    When I enable the status tree view
    Then the status tree should list issues in parent-then-child order

  Scenario: Tree nodes are collapsible
    When I collapse a parent node
    Then descendants are hidden
    When I expand that node
    Then descendants are visible again

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Tree toggle, collapse, default expand, sibling order, and placeholder specs pass in both runtimes.

right_now_summary: Tree view behavior, including collapse and default expansion, passes in both runtimes.
